title: RAG Systems — Retrieve Broadly, Then Rerank
key_insight: Hybrid search combines vector and keyword signals. A reranker then scores a smaller candidate set with deeper query-document comparison.
body:
## Retrieve Broadly, Then Rerank

The nearest embeddings are topically related but do not answer the exact question. Semantic similarity alone is too broad.

Hybrid search combines vector and keyword signals. A reranker then scores a smaller candidate set with deeper query-document comparison.

Evaluate retrieval separately with known relevant passages. If the source never reaches the prompt, changing generation instructions cannot fix the answer.
common_mistakes: RAG permanently writes every document into model weights.
Retrieval guarantees the final answer is correct.
Retrieved documents should override system instructions.
mini_exercise: Draw “Retrieve Broadly, Then Rerank” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: RAG connects models to current or private knowledge without retraining the model for every document change.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Retrieve Broadly, Then Rerank,” explain RAG Systems without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
